name: Gibraltar

findings.summary: Pelagos Data Centres, with Government of Gibraltar backing, announced a privately funded AI data-centre campus of up to 250MW near the port, in five phases to 2033, first phase targeted for late 2027, powered off-grid by renewables and LNG.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: owner-operator's home jurisdiction is not stated (offices in London and Gibraltar; chairman named as Konstantin Sokolov); no investors named. Tier 1 because only a plan was announced; construction was slated for 2026 but no start was found in one follow-up search. Announced value about GBP 1.8bn, not converted (no source-date rate in run). Not marked corroborated because the trade report appears to relay the launch announcement rather than independently confirm it. Off-grid LNG/renewable power is part of this plan, not coded separately.

findings.local_actor: Royal Gibraltar Police (data controller); HM Government of Gibraltar
findings.summary: Ahead of the UK-EU treaty border arrangements, Gibraltar rolled out an expanded CCTV network with live facial recognition and ANPR at the border, airport, Main Street and Casemates, monitored from an airport control room; first-week operation reported in July 2026.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole and controller null: neither opened source names the camera, facial-recognition software vendor or the security contractor operating the system, so the stack pole cannot be assigned. Tier 5 because the system was reported operating territory-wide in July 2026. Corroboration covers the deployment, not any vendor.

networks.null_reason: three searches: Gibtelecom launched 5G in June 2021 (opened operator release names no equipment vendor); only a 2003 Ericsson GPRS award surfaced; no Gibraltar high-risk-vendor decision found

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchase or export-licence item surfaced, and the Pelagos campus names no chip vendor

models.null_reason: one search found only Gibraltar Chronicle items on AI regulation consultation and an AI summit speech; no provider partnership or sovereign model named

power.null_reason: only AI-tied power evidence is the planned off-grid LNG/renewable supply inside the Pelagos plan (GIB-001), with no separate owner or instrument

research_gaps: Radio and core network equipment vendors for Gibtelecom (2G-5G) and any second mobile operator; whether Gibraltar adopted UK-style high-risk-vendor restrictions.
Pelagos Data Centres' corporate domicile and investors, and whether construction started in 2026 (planned Q1 2026 technical briefing).
Vendor of the Royal Gibraltar Police live facial recognition software, cameras and ANPR, and the identity of the operating security contractor.
Any government AI tool adoption (e.g. Microsoft Copilot) or provider partnership.
